newsitem.title: SPAIN: GAS NATURAL TO INVEST 90 BLN PTAS OVER FIVE YRS.
newsitem.headline: GAS NATURAL TO INVEST 90 BLN PTAS OVER FIVE YRS.

text.p: Spain's Gas Natural said on Friday it would invest 90 billion pesetas over the next five years in building electricity plants.

After 10 years, the company hopes to reach a total capacity of 3,000 megawatts, a Gas Natural spokeswoman said. Each electricity unit will produce 400 megawatts and involve an investment of 25,000 billion pesetas.
The electricity will be sold at a central pool to the best bidder.
The company said it was studying up to 10 locations for plants throughout Spain.
Gas Natural said it would carry out the project on its own, outside the boundaries of its accord with Iberdrola and Repsol.
